name: Necromancer Frigid Death raises Glacial Impact damage by 50% (#700)
contract: Frigid Death 560851 is a Rime talent (CharacterAdvancement 5605, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 60, TalentEssenceCost 1) whose description reads 'Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by $s1%.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = 50, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x10000000) in SpellFamilyName 29. The only damage spell with that family flag is Glacial Impact's damage 707592 (SCHOOL_DAMAGE, family flags 0, 0, 0x10000000), which every Glacial Impact rank (704355, 707911, 707399-707402) triggers through effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE; the other flag holder, Animate: Crypt Fiend 801941, deals no damage. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone multiplies the done damage by the caster's SPELLMOD_DAMAGE modifiers, so the native done-damage calculation for 707592 must be exactly 1.5 times its value without the talent, while Lichfrost 801722 (family flags 0, 0, 0x8000000) stays unchanged.
